You are passionate about being in a visionary, hectic and results-driven environment, where you are approachable and deliberate, while working well prepared and attentively, focussing on the customer and his needs. You are able to do it right the first time and can take the long haul that leads to results.

Why are you choosing this job?

You are motivated to work in a modern company, with focus on personal well-being and development and characterized by short chains of command and a very high level of information. In addition to sales, you are driven by:

• Pioneering spirit

• Fast pace with flexible work hours

• Good carreer opportunities in an international environment

The application

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Nikolaj Johansen by phone +45 6021 5010.

Start date: As soon as possible

We welcome your application by post or email

About Us

At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.

We require a physical presence in our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. We believe this enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles to build an impactful product that users love to use.

The Job

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.

In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:

• 
Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.

• 
OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.

• 
Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.

• 
Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.

• 
Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.

• 
Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.

Qualifications:

• 
Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.

• 
Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python

• 
Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.

• 
Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.

• 
Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.

• 
Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers

• 
Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.

• 
Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• 
Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.

• 
Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.

• 
Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.

What We Offer

• 
Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

• 
A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Do you want to influence how one of Europe's leading pharmaceutical companies leverages technology to create competitive advantage? As IT Business Partner for Pharma Trade, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, shaping strategic priorities and using digital innovation to enable greater growth, efficiency, and scalability

About the job

You will work closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders across Pharma Trade to understand business strategy, commercial priorities, operational challenges, and digital opportunities. You will shape demand and identify how technology can improve decision-making, gross margin, operational scalability, process efficiency, and execution across the Pharma Trade value chain.

You will play a central role in developing and maintaining the technology roadmap for Pharma Trade. This includes connecting needs and opportunities across Business Development, Product Supply, Portfolio Management, Hospital and Tender Management, Regulatory, Sales, and other relevant functions.

Working closely with the Head of Pharma Trade Solutions, Product Owner, delivery teams, and shared IT functions, you will ensure that demand is clearly understood, prioritized, qualified, and prepared for successful delivery. You will help move Pharma Trade towards a coherent, scalable, and value-driven digital landscape.

Your focus will not only be on identifying new initiatives, but also on ensuring that technology investments lead to measurable business outcomes and support the long-term transformation of Pharma Trade.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Act as the primary strategic IT partner and point of contact for new technology demand across Pharma Trade

• Build and maintain a consolidated, value-based technology roadmap for Pharma Trade in close collaboration with business leadership and the Pharma Trade Solutions team

• Develop a deep understanding of Pharma Trade’s end-to-end value chain, business processes, decision points, data needs, and application landscape

• Identify, assess, and develop digital opportunities that can improve gross margin, commercial decision-making, scalability, time-to-market, supply visibility, and operational efficiency

• Ensure that initiatives are prioritized across the entire Pharma Trade domain rather than optimized for individual functions or markets

• Challenge business demand constructively and distinguish between underlying business problems, requested features, and appropriate technology solutions

• Secure clear business ownership of business cases, benefits, process decisions, data, adoption, and value realization

• Coordinate early involvement from Product Owners, Solution Architecture, Data & Analytics, Integration, Cyber Security, Compliance, and other shared IT functions

Who are you?

You are a senior, business-oriented IT professional who combines strong stakeholder management with a structured and analytical approach to technology demand and business value.

You understand both business priorities and IT delivery realities. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, but you also have enough technology understanding to challenge, shape, and qualify ideas before they become projects.

You bring:

• Experience in IT business partnering, IT strategy, digital transformation, technology consulting, product ownership, or a similar cross-functional IT role

• Experience from life sciences is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Good understanding of enterprise IT, business applications, architecture, integrations, software delivery, and implementation processes

• Understanding of commercial and operational processes such as business development, product and portfolio management, sourcing and supply planning, pricing, forecasting, and allocation

• Experience working with complex, cross-functional business domains where value is created through connected processes, data, and decision-making

• Experience with product-oriented delivery, demand management, business cases, prioritization, and benefits realization

• Analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and competing priorities

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 45 professionals across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices. The team is solution-oriented and highly engaged in creating value across Orifarm. We have a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and flexibility, where helping each other succeed is a core principle.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Do you have a strong creative vision, exceptional sketching abilities, and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials, and the jewellery design process? Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

Requirements

• 
Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• 
Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• 
Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• 
Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• 
Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• 
Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• 
Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Our systems support a wide range of high-tech products and environments from rack servers and laptops to embedded systems deployed across remote customer sites.  At the core is a strong Linux foundation, combined with cloud infrastructure, automation, observability and secure operations.

As part of our Infrastructure DevOps team, you will work closely with software development, support, and operations to design new infrastructure solutions and solve complex operational challenges for customers in Denmark, across Europe, the USA, and Japan.

You will have the opportunity to interact with various high-tech products and technologies such as Doppler radars, machine vision, and 3D graphics.  Creating the tools and resources to help build a reliable, scalable, and secure cloud-connected infrastructure platform.

What will you be doing?

• 
Develop and maintain robust cloud and infrastructure platforms supporting thousands of distributed Linux-based systems.

• 
Design, deploy, and operate scalable cloud infrastructure, networking, and automation solutions across multiple environments.

• 
Build reliable tools, services, and deployment pipelines for software development, support, and operations teams.

• 
Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and configuration using infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practices.

• 
Improve observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, and automated recovery mechanisms.

• 
Define and implement security policies, firewall rules, access controls, and cloud hardening practices.

• 
Support cost, performance, reliability, and delivery improvements across a constantly evolving infrastructure landscape.

• 
Contribute to the architecture and direction of our DevOps and Azure cloud infrastructure platform.

• 
Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, networks, Linux servers, containers, and distributed systems.

Developing customer-facing software – you will support internal development teams

• 
Providing IT support or installing workstations for your colleagues

• 
Physically installing servers and networks at remote locations – that is handled by field operations

Who are you?

• 
You have 4+ years of experience in a similar role, such as DevOps Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, Linux Systems Administrator, Network Engineer, Security Engineer, or Software Developer working in complex infrastructure environments.

• 
You have strong knowledge of the Linux ecosystem, both on physical hardware and in cloud environments.

• 
You have experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.

• 
You are comfortable working with container-based systems and modern deployment practices.

• 
You enjoy solving complex technical problems and are comfortable writing scripts, tools, or code to automate your work.

• 
You thrive in a collaborative environment where development, operations, support, and field teams work closely together.

Relevant Skills / Experience:

• 
Python or another programming language

• 
Azure, AWS, or similar cloud platforms

• 
Terraform, Ansible, SaltStack, Puppet, Chef, or similar automation and infrastructure-as-code tools

• 
Cloud security, infrastructure hardening, identity and access management, and network security practices

• 
Docker/Podman or container runtimes

• 
Monitoring, alerting, and incident response tooling

• 
Virtualization technologies such as Proxmox, VMware or Hyper-V

• 
Linux networking, iptables, nftables, VPNs, and firewall configuration

Intrusion detection and prevention systems

• 
Kubernetes experience:

• 
Hands-on experience architecting, building and operating Kubernetes clusters at scale.

• 
Experience designing highly available Kubernetes clusters across on-premises and cloud environments.

• 
Solid understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including building and managing both the control plane and data plane.

• 
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes networking, including DNS, Ingress/Gateway API, load balancing and CNI.

What we offer

• 
A technically challenging role with meaningful ownership of cloud and infrastructure solutions.

• 
Interesting and engaging tasks that would let your creative mind shine

• 
Highly skilled and motivated colleagues who are eager to share knowledge — and learn from you.

• 
The opportunity to help shape the direction of a growing DevOps team.

• 
Start-up like flexibility, but with security and backing of a leading industry brand

• 
A healthy balance between work, professional growth, and social life.

ABENA is a family owned company built on trust, fairness, and collaboration. With more than 2,200 colleagues worldwide, they serve customers across 90+ markets in healthcare, industry, and retail. At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: to make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. Set the direction for global procurement – strengthen ABENA’s competitiveness

With global sourcing units, a significant yearly spend, and more than 29,000 products, procurement is a key commercial driver of the business.

As Global Procurement Director, you will have overall responsibility for the continued development of ABENA’s category-based procurement, with the aim of ensuring that individual categories contribute even more significantly to driving the business forward. Your responsibilities will also include global sourcing and supply chain planning & execution.

The role is positioned at the highest level of management. You will report directly to the CEO, be a member of the ABENA Leadership Team and lead a global organisation of approximately 60 employees. Your direct reports will include two Heads of Procurement, the Head of Supply Chain Planning & Execution, and the Head of Master Data.

This is a key position with significant influence on the Group’s profitability, security of supply, and competitiveness. At the same time, the ambition is to further strengthen procurement’s position in the value chain and in ABENA’s strategic management.

The tasks/your responsibilities

In addition to further developing the category-based procurement organisation, one of your most important responsibilities will be to contribute to the digital transformation across the value chain. You will build and ensure efficient processes across categories, countries and sourcing units. Is your mind set on innovation and developing the next generation of high-protein dairy products?

Are you looking for a role where you can combine deep process expertise, product development excellence and capability building to shape the future of Fermented High Protein products?

This could be your chance to join a leading global dairy company that takes innovation, product superiority and process excellence seriously. The job location is based in our Arla Innovation Centre in Aarhus.

“You will be part of our Fermented High Protein Innovation team, helping to create superior products, strengthen our process capabilities and build the knowledge foundations needed for future growth. So, if you are passionate about working in a fast-paced international environment and want to make a significant impact on the future of Skyr, Quark, Greek yoghurt and other high-protein dairy platforms, this could be your next career move_,” says Associate Director – High Protein Fermented Innovation, Jorden Naseby

Create Product & Process Excellence for Fermented High Protein Innovation

We are looking to strengthen process capability across our Fermented High Protein organisation.

Your main goal is to combine hands-on product development with process leadership, helping the team make robust, data-driven decisions and creating the tools, knowledge and best practices needed to accelerate innovation. You will work closely with Innovation, Science, Operations, Quality, Packaging, Marketing and Supply Chain teams across Europe.

This position places you in a unique role where you will influence both today's products and the future capability of the organisation. You will drive deep process development expertise to support capex investment projects across our network of production sites.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading complex product and process development projects from concept to launch.

• Acting as a product and process expert across fermented high-protein product platforms including Skyr, Quark, yoghurt and emerging technologies.

• Driving laboratory, pilot and industrial trials and translating technical findings into clear business recommendations.

• Identifying and solving complex product quality, stability and process challenges.

• Leading knowledge in process and product interactions within the team.

• Developing technical playbooks, guidelines, troubleshooting tools and best-practice ways of working.

• Establishing structured approaches for experimentation, data interpretation and root-cause analysis.

• Contributing to future product and technology roadmaps within Fermented High Protein.

• Supporting external manufacturing, supplier collaborations and Contract Manufacturing activities where specialist technical expertise is required.

Inventive, product and processing expert, strong and able to challenge the status quo.

If you hold a degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, Food Engineering or a related discipline, and have significant experience in product & process development within dairy or food manufacturing, you may have the credentials we are looking for.

You are passionate about applying science to solve real business challenges and have a proven ability to translate technical complexity into practical solutions.

Experience within fermented dairy products, high-protein products, fermentation, process development & large-scale manufacturing is a necessity.

You are comfortable influencing without authority and can work effectively across multiple functions, sites and cultures. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others develop technical confidence and capability.

This role requires:

• Technical leadership in process and site capabilities across the network.

• Strong product and process development expertise.

• Analytical and data-driven decision making.

• Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Finally, you build strong relationships, challenge constructively and thrive in an environment where innovation, learning and collaboration are valued.

Application & Contact

If you want to seize this opportunity to help shape the future of Fermented High Protein Innovation and accelerate your career, then please apply as soon as possible.

We process applications on a continuous basis and close the posting once the right candidate has been found.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers—automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don't just use Light—they enjoy it.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernize how the world runs money—one workflow at a time—you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

This Integrations Engineer role

Light is only as powerful as the systems it connects to. Money doesn't move because we say so—it moves because we speak the language of the bank, the e-invoicing network, and the planning tool on the other side, correctly, every time, for every customer entity. This role owns that layer: the interaction surface between Light and the rest of the financial world.

You'll build and operate the integrations that let Light plug into multi-tenant banking APIs (J.P. Morgan, HSBC, and peers), global e-invoicing networks, and tax platforms and more. This is backend-heavy, data-integrity-critical work where a dropped message or a silent reconciliation mismatch is not an acceptable outcome. You'll design the abstractions that turn a dozen incompatible partner APIs into one coherent internal model, and you'll keep those abstractions honest as partners change their specs underneath you.

What you'll work on:

• 
Bank connectivity. Build against corporate banking and payments APIs—account information, payment initiation, status reporting, FX—across providers like J.P. Morgan Payments and HSBC. Handle the realities of bank integrations: certificate-based and mTLS auth, OAuth flows, ISO 20022 (pain/pacs/camt) and legacy MT formats, sandbox-to-production parity, and rate limits that assume you're a bank, not a startup.

• 
Multi-tenancy done right. Our customers are many legal entities operating in many countries. You'll design integrations where credentials, configuration, and data are isolated per tenant, where onboarding a new entity is a workflow rather than a code change, and where one customer's failure never leaks into another's.

• 
Global e-invoicing. Connect Light to e-invoicing networks and country-specific mandates (Peppol and the growing set of national clearance and reporting regimes). Map between formats, manage compliance-driven edge cases, and keep delivery auditable.

• 
Tax platforms for statutory filing, US sales tax and much more.

• 
Reliability and reconciliation. Idempotency, retries, webhook and polling strategies, dead-letter handling, and end-to-end reconciliation so that what we think happened and what actually happened always agree.

Your qualifications

4-6 years of experience ideally, plus…

You build things. Not prototypes, not demos. Working software in production, doing something real for real users. This is the non-negotiable.

You've built integrations against unforgiving external systems. APIs you don't control, that fail in ways the docs don't mention, where correctness is contractual. You know how to defend a system against a partner that returns a 200 with an error in the body.

You know banking and payments APIs. Direct, hands-on experience with corporate banking, treasury, or payments APIs is what sets the strongest candidates apart. Experience integrating J.P. Morgan or HSBC specifically—their developer platforms, auth models, and payment and reporting APIs—is highly valuable and a genuine differentiator for this role. Familiarity with ISO 20022, SWIFT, virtual accounts, or open banking is a strong signal.

You are excited about AI. You use AI tooling efficiently to improve your work. At Light, a lot of code is written with AI, which means the hard part is increasingly the thinking: deciding what to build, reviewing what comes back, and catching where the model is confidently wrong. You know when AI speeds you up, when it's likely to mislead you, and how to lean on it while staying fully responsible for what ships.

You're comfortable across the stack. You don't need to be a specialist in everything, but you can't have a lane you refuse to leave. Our stack is Kotlin and React, and this role leans backend. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, that works.

You care about data integrity. You think about the person on the other end and the money moving between them. You notice when a flow is correct but fragile, and you act on it.

You ship early and often. Small batches. Learn. Go again. You'd rather put something real in front of a customer than spend another week perfecting it in isolation.

Bonus points

• 
Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

• 
Familiarity with accounting concepts: debits, credits, reconciliation

• 
Experience with e-invoicing standards or country-specific compliance regimes

• 
Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out

Our Tech Stack

We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It's a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day. The integration layer you'll own sits squarely in the Kotlin backend, talking to a long list of external partners. You don't need to have used every piece of it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

• 
A competitive salary + potential stock options

• 
25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based

• 
Regular socials and company off-sites

• 
A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining product

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before—and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off.

Working at

Light

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

JOIN Terotech

Ready for a career that's challenging, fun, and ever changing?

Terotech has your back on maintaining your equipment.

Working at Terotech

At Terotech, you do more than maintain equipment - you keep large assets running that support critical infrastructure.

We're 50+ people based in Esbjerg, working in Denmark and internationally. Oil & gas, energy, manufacturing - all industries where downtime isn't an option. You learn fast, solve real problems, and see results immediately.

A Place You'll Want to Stay

We work hard - but the industries we serve demand it. That said, we believe work should be somewhere you want to show up. Where colleagues become friends, and people actually care about how your week went.

We meet by the coffee machine. We solve problems as a team. We celebrate wins and support each other continually. The social side isn't extra, but part of our DNA.

Here's something we're proud of: People who've left for other opportunities often stay in touch. Some come back. A few have said they missed the people and culture as much as the work itself. That's the kind of workplace we want to keep building.

Considering a career in Terotech?

We hire for technical skill and personal fit. You need to be a team player who takes initiative, follows through, and speaks up when something isn't right. Our culture is built on five core values: curiosity, openness, empathy, trust, and integrity. This is what you can expect from us, and what we expect from you.

Curiosity

means we keep learning - from each other, and from the problems we solve. We don't just execute tasks, we're curious about understanding our client's world.

Openness

shows in how we communicate. We say what we mean, admit when we don't know something, and share knowledge freely. No hidden agendas.

Empathy

means we see the person, not just the role. Good maintenance work starts with understanding what actually matters to the people involved.

Trust

is earned through follow-through. We do what we say we'll do. We honor the trust clients place in us when they hand over responsibility for their operations.

Integrity

means we speak up when something isn't right - whether it's a safety issue, an unsound plan, or a colleague who needs support.

our People

Maintenance engineers

who’ve kept industrial facilities running for year, both offshore and onshore.

Mechanics and technicians

with decades of hands-on experience in high-stakes environments.

Electricians

who can troubleshoot complex systems under pressure.

Asset Management specialists

who turn data into decisions.

Programmers and data analysts

who build systems people want use.

Project managers

who keep everything on track.

Considering a career in Terotech?

Check our open positions

We’re always looking for talented colleagues who share our values and want to do meaningful work. If you think you’d be a good fit, send us an unsolicited application to Jannie Schlosser Lund at jsl@tero.tech and tell us what you’re good at and why you want to be part of our team.

Maintenance Engineer

We are looking for an ambitious new colleague to join our young and dynamic team. You are motivated by making a real difference within maintenance and asset management and are eager to help organizations improve the performance and sustainability of their physical assets. In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop into a leading advisor within the field. You will work hands-on with our solutions, taking them from concept to implementation and seeing the results delivered directly at both existing and future client sites.

Esbjerg, Denmark

Full-time
